requirement_basis.r2_observable: Twelve previously unseen writing tasks satisfy length, content, purpose and format
requirement_basis.applied_slice: Select and persist either bullet or paragraph layout for explicitly supplied extractive summary candidates; this does not establish natural-language format interpretation, purpose, content quality or semantic coverage.

implementation.request_contract: Strict JSON requires text and max_sentences; optional max_chars remains 1..100000 Unicode scalars, and optional format accepts only bullets or paragraph. Missing format defaults to bullets.
implementation.layout: bullets prefixes every complete copied sentence with newline plus dash-space. paragraph places one newline after the disclosure and joins complete copied sentences with one space. The artifact stores the effective format.
implementation.selection: Existing deterministic token-frequency/first-sentence/long-sentence ranking and complete-sentence selection remain unchanged; selected sentences are restored to source order.
implementation.budget_unit: Sum of copied sentence Unicode scalar values. Disclosure text, layout markers and separators are excluded.
implementation.invalid_format_behavior: Unsupported, null or non-string format suspends with TEXT_SUMMARY_SCHEMA and creates no artifact.
artifact_fields: exact source and output byte spans
implementation.known_gap: The route does not infer a user purpose or requested format from natural language and does not verify relevance, completeness, meaning, conditions, negation, factual truth, audience, style or writing quality.
